data.title: Cambodia gives Myanmar post-coup leader red-carpet reception
data.description: PHNOM PENH — Cambodia gave Myanmar's coup leader turned civilian president a red-carpet welcome on Friday, images from his office showed, as another nation embraced the ex-junta chief back into the diplomatic fold.

data.title: Over 30% of unmarried people in Japan do not want children: survey
data.description: KYODO — More than 30% of unmarried people aged between 18 and 34 in Japan do not wish to have children, the highest percentage since comparable data became available in 2002, a government survey showed Friday.

data.title: Italian feminist fighter Emma Bonino dies
data.description: ROME - Italy's Emma Bonino, a long-time radical activist and one of the country's most popular political figures, has died aged 78.

data.title: Indonesia to bring back baby orangutans allegedly trafficked to India
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesian authorities have begun working to repatriate five baby orangutans allegedly trafficked to India, where they were found motherless in a forest, Jakarta's forestry ministry told AFP Friday.

data.title: Fast-pace dance takes I.Coast's working-class streets by storm
data.description: ABIDJAN - On the streets of a working-class Abidjan neighbourhood, hundreds of young people gather every week after class to dance the biama, a high-tempo combo of acrobatic twists, frenetic footwork and funny facial expressions.

data.title: Myanmar airport shut after rebel drone attack
data.description: MANDALAY — Myanmar's second-busiest airport was closed for two days on Friday, security sources told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ), a day after the military-backed government accused pro-democracy rebels of attacking it with drones.

data.title: Putin in India for Brics summit overshadowed by war
data.description: NEW DELHI - Russian President Vladimir Putin was in India on Friday for talks ahead of an 11-member BRICS (Brics) summit dominated by conflict and economic challenges, with the leaders of China and Iran set to attend.

data.title: A succession battle erupts over a late Ugandan monarch
data.description: NEW YORK — A television anchor. A young, mysterious heir. An amateur football player nicknamed “Big G.” Those were the people offered as candidates for the throne of the Tooro Kingdom in Uganda, after its former boy king died of cancer at age 34 last month.

data.title: Kim Jong Un wants North Koreans to have more (state-sanctioned) fun
data.description: Recent developments in North Korea include shopping malls, beach ​resorts, waterparks

data.title: The Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil activists convicted in national security trial
data.description: HONG KONG - A Hong Kong court sentenced three pro-democracy activists on Friday who organised annual vigils to mark China's deadly Tiananmen crackdown on charges of "incitement to subversion".

data.title: Appreciation, anger await as Trump heads to Irish golf resort
data.description: DOONBEG — In the windswept village of Doonbeg on Ireland's Atlantic coast, Donald Trump is less polarising United States president and more golf resort owner credited with bringing jobs and money to a remote corner of the country.

data.title: Party leaders trade barbs before Swedish election
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Sweden's party leaders traded barbs on housing, schools, jobs and the climate in one of their final televised debates ahead of Sunday's general election, which could see a left-wing government come to power.

data.title: Manchester derby poses Maresca's first big test, Chelsea aim to end Hull Honeymoon
data.description: MANCHESTER — Enzo Maresca faces his first major test since stepping into Pep Guardiola's shoes as City visit United in the Manchester derby on Sunday, while Arsenal aim to extend their flawless start at Sunderland.

data.title: Statecraft or scripture: Why Pacific nations want Jerusalem embassies
data.description: SYDNEY — An ancient Biblical prophecy lies at the heart of a Pacific islands push to open embassies on contested ground in Jerusalem, experts and former diplomats told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ).

data.title: China, Iran among countries that have used AI to aid spying, Anthropic says
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO - Anthropic said on Thursday it shut down multiple cases of state-sponsored surveillance operations that used its artificial intelligence (AI) models, and warned that governments and state-aligned actors are increasingly using AI to spy on ethnic minorities and dissidents.

data.title: Hong Kong sentences Tiananmen activists to between 5 and 7 years in jail
data.description: HONG KONG — A Hong Kong court handed three Tiananmen vigil activists jail sentences of between five and seven years on Friday for national security crimes, following a trial that has drawn international condemnation.

data.title: Musk threatens legal action over documentary
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Elon Musk's lawyers put the makers of a new four-hour documentary about the multibillionaire on formal legal notice days before its premiere, warning that the film defames him.

data.title: Tremor recorded as Israel says Hezbollah tunnels destroyed in south Lebanon
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israel said Thursday it demolished key tunnels built by the Iran-backed Hezbollah group beneath the strategic Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon, triggering a 4.1 magnitude tremor.

data.title: Carney says in touch with Trump, Canada ready for 'fair' trade deal
data.description: CALGARY (CANADA) - Prime Minister Mark Carney said Thursday that he had spoken to US President Donald Trump "in recent days" and Ottawa remains ready to reach a "fair" trade deal with Washington, despite escalating economic tensions.

data.title: Canada pledges support for Ukraine air defense as Zelensky visits
data.description: CALGARY (CANADA) - Canada offered support Thursday to boost Ukraine's air defenses and help replenish its drone stocks, as the countries pledged to deepen their alliance during a visit by President Volodymyr Zelensky.
